{{Quote|We're all expendable. Expendable. The mission is all-important.|Orvak, right after the death of Dareb|<ref name="YJK JUS" />}}
[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Orvak''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer who, from his [[TIE stealth]], led a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] attack during the [[Third Battle of Yavin|battle of the Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

Accompanied by his subordinate [[Dareb]], Commander Orvak flew under the [[Jedi Praxeum]]'s [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]]. However, Dareb was killed when his TIE crashed into a tree, and Orvak had to blow up the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] on his own using [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. He then sneaked into the deserted [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], where he planted further detonators and had to avoid an attack by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. He was bitten by a [[Crystal snake/Legends|crystal snake]], only regaining consciousness as his bombs were about to explode. Orvak was killed in the blast.
